div.p: Welcome to the complete Warehouse System training library. Everything you need to learn this system on your own is here — no instructor required. Work top to bottom for your role.

ul.li: 📖 Read the guides below in order (each is short and uses real trust examples).
▶️ Watch — where an article has a video player at the top, press play. Videos are added over time; an empty player just means that clip isn't recorded yet.
🔎 Search the Help Center any time you hit a word you don't know (try "FIFO", "compartment", "slot").
💡 Beginner Mode (ON by default) shows extra hints under fields. Turn it off in your Preferences once you're confident.

div.p: You receive, put away, issue, and return stock, and you report damage. Learn in this order:

ol.li: Getting started as a Store Keeper — what you do each shift.
Barcodes & scanners — how scanning works.
Receiving stock — Scan Receipt: log what arrives, record who was on duty.
Putaway — get each item to its slot (Rack → Shelf → Compartment → Slot).
Issuing stock (FIFO) — the system hands you the oldest stock first; take a photo, record the keeper.
Returns — booking returnable items back in (fluids/consumables are refused).
Damaged goods & Repairs — what to do when something breaks.
Stock counts / audits — counting a shelf and submitting the result (it locks once submitted).

div.p: You build the warehouse map, onboard products, manage people, and watch the dashboards. Learn in this order:

ol.li: What this system is and what it does — the big picture.
Warehouse structure — Zones, Racks, Compartments, Slots, and the three Generators that create them in seconds.
Onboard products — paste a list from Excel; each item gets an auto-SKU, barcode, and label.
Users & permissions — Manager vs Store Keeper, the capability tick-boxes, and the on-duty roster.
Stock flow: FIFO / FEFO — how the system decides what leaves first.
Audit trail & roster — who did what, and why audits lock.
Reports — occupancy, movement history, oldest stock, expiry alerts, forecasts.
Backups & restore drill, then Observability / health — keeping the data safe and the system green.
Damage & repair oversight and Troubleshooting.
What you can and cannot do.
Using reports and Searching stock — find anything without changing it.
Audit visibility — read the history.
Safe viewing — you can't break anything; look freely.

div.p: Each workflow has a ready-to-record script and an exact click-path checklist (kept with the project in docs/training/). To publish a recorded clip, open the matching article and use the Training video (upload) field or the Video link field — see "How do I add a training video?" for the steps.

p.i: This index links the existing terminology, role-training, workflow, FAQ, troubleshooting, and safety articles into one course. Use the Help Center search or the category groups to open any of them directly.
